description: Official US mortgage application totals from the CFPB HMDA Data Browser API for one state and year: number of loans and their total dollar amount (aggregated, no borrower data). Filter by HMDA action taken (1 = loan originated, default). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

actionTaken.description: HMDA action taken code (default 1 = loan originated)

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. WI

name: realestate_hmda_mortgage_loan_data
title: Realestate Hmda Mortgage Loan Data
